content:
The slim girl, named Sarah, grew up in a poor family where food was scarce. She always dreamed of being able to eat as much as she wanted and finally feel full. So when she heard about a job opening at a local restaurant, she saw an opportunity to make her dream come true.

Sarah went to the restaurant and pleaded with the owner to hire her as a waitress, promising that she wouldn't ask for any money in exchange for a place to stay and the leftover food of the restaurant. The owner, who was struggling to keep the restaurant afloat, agreed to the deal.

As days went by, Sarah indulged in the leftover food of the restaurant, which was often thrown away due to its poor quality. She ate to her heart's content and slowly but surely, she started gaining weight. At first, she was overjoyed to see her body filling out and becoming curvier.

But as time passed, Sarah's weight gain spiraled out of control. She grew so large that she could no longer fit through doors or move around easily. She became trapped within the confines of the restaurant, unable to use the restroom or leave the premises.

Sarah's hygiene deteriorated as she was unable to clean herself properly, and the restaurant soon began to lose customers due to the unsanitary conditions. The owner, unable to recoup his losses, eventually went bankrupt and was forced to shut down the restaurant.

Left alone in an abandoned building, Sarah realized the consequences of her insatiable appetite. She was now confined to live in her own dirt, with no one to care for her or help her escape her predicament. It was a harsh lesson for the girl who once longed to be fat, as she now found herself alone and abandoned, surrounded by the remnants of her own greed.
